description: MCP server exposing LS증권 OpenAPI (REST) as tools. Read-only Korean stock market data and analysis via natural language.
releaseNotes: v0.6.0 (net +2 tools, 37 → 39): Market context (ls_get_index_quote via t1511 + ls_get_industry_indices via t8424+t1511 fanout with 60s cache + ls_get_industry_stocks via t1516), LS themes (ls_get_theme_stocks via t1537 with header continuation + ls_get_stock_themes via t1532), portfolio JSON export/import (schema v1, mode=merge/replace with before-import auto-backup), fire-and-forget t1532 theme enrichment with metadata_freshness hint, holdings_list theme_code/theme_keyword filters with matched_themes echo. BREAKING — Tier 1 compression (−5): ls_account_get + ls_account_set_default removed (use accounts_list[].is_default + upsert(set_default=true)), ls_holdings_split/_reverse_split/_bonus collapsed into ls_holdings_corporate_action(type, ratio) with open enum for v0.7+ extensions. BREAKING — watched_sectors → watched_themes rename (DB schema v3 migration preserves v0.5 data). v0.7 deferred: stocks.krx_sector enrichment and industry filter (confirmed t1102 lacks the field). See https://github.com/redoxnet/mcp-lsopenapi/blob/main/RELEASENOTES.Mcp.md for full notes.
